visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a black spaghetti strap camisole, sits cross-legged on a tiled floor. She holds a white knitted garment and looks thoughtfully upward, her eyes moving as if contemplating something. In front of her is an open black suitcase with denim jeans and other clothing items scattered nearby. The background features clean white minimalist cabinetry under bright indoor lighting. (2) As she continues her internal debate, a man wearing a dark olive t-shirt and dark shorts walks behind her across the room, looking at his phone. The woman adjusts her hair and rests her chin on her hand, her facial expression showing deep concentration and slight frustration. The setting remains the same bright, tidy indoor space with neutral tones and clean lines. (3) She picks up a white sneaker and then a black-and-white slide, comparing them visually. Her movements are slightly exaggerated to emphasize her indecision. She gestures with her hands while looking at the ceiling, seemingly talking to herself about her travel plans. The clothing on the floor is shifted as she reaches for different items. (4) The scene shifts as the man returns to the frame, now wearing a white t-shirt, dark shorts, and sunglasses, pulling a large black suitcase adorned with several stickers. A light-colored dog, possibly a labrador or retriever, walks into the frame behind him. The woman remains seated on the floor, looking up at him with a startled expression as he interrupts her thoughts.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 女生旅遊前的心理狀態. [Subtitle]: 這次去首爾五天要拍穿搭. (2) [Subtitle]: 應該每天都要穿不一樣了吧. (3) [Subtitle]: 那這樣就是穿一套帶四套. (4) [Subtitle]: 第一天搭飛機機場會冷. (5) [Subtitle]: 嗯~那我會穿著外套. (6) [Subtitle]: 可是那邊要30度耶. (7) [Subtitle]: 我外套脫下來要放哪?. (8) [Subtitle]: 那要背大包包嗎?. (9) [Subtitle]: 蛤~可是我想搭配小包耶. (10) [Subtitle]: 啊! 好像最近梅雨季要記得帶傘. (11) [Subtitle]: 那包包不就又要放下雨傘. (12) [Subtitle]: 喔好煩. (13) [Subtitle]: 我等一下要先去洗頭. (14) [Subtitle]: 這樣第一天搭飛機很累. (15) [Subtitle]: 我就可以偷懶. (16) [Subtitle]: 第二天再洗. (17) [Subtitle]: 第三天可以戴帽子. (18) [Subtitle]: 可是那天穿搭好像不搭耶. (19) [Subtitle]: 嗯...不然改成綁包包頭好了. (20) [Subtitle]: 嗯! 就這樣. (21) [Subtitle]: 那我要帶幾雙鞋啊?. (22) [Subtitle]: 應該會一直逛街所以要帶好走的. (23) [Subtitle]: 可是我又想帶上次新買的那雙. (24) [Subtitle]: 啊! 去那邊應該也會買鞋吧. (25) [Subtitle]: 可是萬一沒買到怎麼辦. (26) [Subtitle]: 算了算了還是先帶著. (27) [Subtitle]: 護照帶了. (28) [Subtitle]: 信用卡帶了. (29) [Subtitle]: 充電線跟化妝包. (30) [Subtitle]: 出發前再裝進去. (31) [Subtitle]: 等一下洗完澡還有三小時可以睡. (32) [Subtitle]: 還是我乾脆不要睡啦. (33) [Subtitle]: 到飛機上睡. (34) [Subtitle]: 欸我都整理完妳在幹嘛?. (35) [Variety]: (別走啊).

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a fast-paced, upbeat acoustic guitar and percussion-driven BGM. A female voice provides a continuous, high-speed narration in Traditional Chinese, characterized by a casual and animated inner-monologue tone. There is a slight rustling sound of fabric being handled as she describes her packing process. (2) A subtle acoustic texture shift occurs as the female narrator's voice becomes slightly more frantic and high-pitched during her debate about the weather and bag choice. The rhythmic BGM maintains a steady 120 BPM tempo. A short percussive thud is heard as she handles footwear. (3) A distinct mechanical rattling sound of suitcase wheels rolling across a hard floor marks a significant acoustic event. A male voice with a lower pitch and authoritative tone enters the mix, interrupting the female narration. The BGM persists but fades slightly as the dialogue concludes.
